text: No, the evidence does not show forest loss across the surrounding region. The observations confirm that the asset had tree cover in 2000, but no forest was detected in 2020 by the JRC dataset. Historical tree-cover loss events (2008, 2015, 2017, 2020) are recorded, totaling 98.8 ha, but these are outside the claim interval (post-2020 baseline). Post-2020 losses are minimal (0.4 ha in 2021) and below the 0.5 ha event threshold. The surrounding region is not analyzed—only the asset (2,843.1 ha) is evaluated.
